text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With magnificent focus,
Shinko Windy sprinted through the Tokai Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Shinko Windy...
So she runs like that, huh.
Her concentration has improved a lot since her debut.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, her gaze used to wander before, but she's really growing.
She's looking straight ahead as she runs.
Maybe she's not just... an entertaining kid...?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
...! T-That's right...!
Windy-chan really is strong, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So this is what happens when all that scattered focus
is channeled purely into her running...
I feel like I've caught a glimpse of her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeew,
I'm~ so~ tiiiired~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But... Windy-chan was super fast noda.
And somehow, I feel refreshed...
Not frustrated at all anymore...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Ah...!
I didn't feel the urge to bite...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible... Senpai really is something else...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She's evolved... since the last time I saw her.
Even the atmosphere in the venue feels a little different...

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The "Biting Umamusume" who was trending a while back put on a performance that exceeded expectations too.
I was on edge for a bit, though! Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Exceeding expectations, huh...
Even so, the public still seems to be taking Windy-senpai lightly...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Senpai is just too strong...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And yet... this makes no sense...!
Something like this...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...At a time like this, a hero...
would never just stand by and watch...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the race concluded. Just as we were about to head home, Shinko Windy stopped in her tracks and looked back at the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer...
How was Windy-chan today?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Uhehe...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Windy-chan thought
something felt different from usual too, nod!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was thanks to that "Darkness Switch"...
I put all those different feelings
right into my legs, every single one of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Every last bit of it. Wanting to win,
the frustration, the regrets, the anger...
All of it... went completely white..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And then, ya know what?
My urge to bite stuff completely vanished!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Like I said! Windy-chan
will definitely never bite anyone during a race again...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to be biting things!
'Cause up ahead on the course, the goal is waiting.
Sparkling and shining...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I know my ambition lies just ahead!
So Windy-chan is just gonna charge right in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe she has grown stronger.
Both in her running and in her heart...
Having watched over her from the closest vantage point, I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ In that case,
let's eat miso katsu before heading home!
And super crispy fried shrimp too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta recharge waaaay up
for our next race, after all~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after sightseeing in Chukyo, we headed home.
Thinking on the Shinkansen, the next race would be...
choice_data_list: Let's go with the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, returning to the GⅠ, are we?
Very well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had heard that the most brilliant dirt Umamusume of the moment would be running in the February Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I've totally heard of that one!
The 'Queen of the Dirt', right!?
I heard she's insanely strong!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"If I beat 'em...! Then everyone'll have no choice
but to recognize Windy-chan's true strength, right!?"
choice_data_list: As you are now, you can win!
As you are now, you can win!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan thinks so too! Right now, Windy-chan has no rivals!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This time for sure, with an overwhelming victory that goes down in history, I'll—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
—Here is our next news story.
In a shocking turn of events, the heavy favorite for this year's February Stakes, the "Queen of Sand," has withdrawn from the race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Minion! Turn up the volume!!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
—Man, sitting it out for an overseas expedition...
Looks like this year's February Stakes
might end up being a bit of a downer.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-No waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: At this rate... Windy-chan won't get to show off how amazing she is...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~! Isn't there some way...
some way to make it flashy...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without any good ideas coming to mind,
adjustments for the February Stakes got underway.
Just then...!

Tap-tap-tap-tap-tap!!
Hup! Trans-FORMA-TION!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Champion of justice and friend to all good kids,
Justice Biko has arrived☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai, I heard! You're running in the February Stakes, right!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Actually... I decided to enter too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat! You too?!
Why would you do something like that...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right there, I'm gonna become
Windy-senpai's rival!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? *You're*...
Windy-chan's rival...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! It's on, Senpai.
I've gotten... stronger too!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If Senpai and I have a serious showdown,
it's bound to be an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Once everyone sees that, they're sure to
realize Senpai's true strength...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So let's show everybody!
Just how strong me and Windy-senpai are!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's how it is.
They said there's no clear favorite
for the February Stakes, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If Biko Pegasus joins the fray, things might really heat up...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko... You...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph... It's true that the stronger my opponents are, the more Windy-chan's own strength shines...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Still, can you even run on dirt!? Just 'cause you had a few decent results on turf, you think you can do it!?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Don't you underestimate me!
A hero can run anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Watch this! Hup—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus sprinted down the track before us.
What an incredible run... And not just that, she even
had the kind of sheer power you'd expect from a dirt runner—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa...
...How's that!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Y-You...! When did you get so...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...! Senior taught me that...!
If you hate the way things are right now, you gotta struggle and fight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This is the result of all my struggling since that day.
It took time, sure,
but as long as you don't give up, you'll get stronger, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I can't just end things on a defeat.
I can't give up on my dream to be a hero...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"You can't just let things end like this either,
right, Senpai? So..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's show 'em what we've got in this clash of ours!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And the crowd at the venue... the public's perception... No, that's not all...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna change the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Change the world, you say...?
What an insolent brat...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious.
Together with Windy-senpai, we can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Together, the two of us are gonna flip the whole world's opinion on its head!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I don't recall ever becoming your rival!
But if you're picking a fight, I'm gonna win it, nanoda!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat 'em black and blue and flatten 'em flat!
I'll make everyone admit that "Windy-chan is the strongest and scariest!" ya knooow~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh♪ That's the spirit!
